rules.focusAccessibleName: Known accessibility loss, accepted by the approved criterion and for Eric to decide at UAT: Round 7's Focus control is named ‘Change focus’ (aria-label), so a screen reader no longer hears the current Focus value — the visible value (for example ‘Lower body’) is not in the accessible name, unlike the build's ‘Focus: <value>’ button and the accepted gallery bec4454's value-named button (‘Upper body’). That is a WCAG 2.5.3 label-in-name gap. The approved criterion (round-07 S4: ‘rewritten to Round 7's Change focus naming where only the name differs’) accepts it; this task does not change Generate.tsx's name. The tests read the name Change focus plus the exact value text.
